indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS & USAGE SECTION Formulated for symptoms associated with food and environmental allergens such as congestion, swollen glands, runny nose, cough, rashes and stomach upset.
dosage_and_administration: DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION SECTION Directions: Ages 12 and up take 6 pellets (ages 0 to 11, give 3 pellets) as needed or directed by a health professional. Under age 2, crush/dissolve pellets in purified water. Sensitive persons begin with 1 pellet and gradually increase to full dose.
